{{BuffInfobox |name = Hidden Detection Buff |image = HiddenDetectionOld.png |type = Buff |display = Tower
Upgrade Menu }} ==Description== The '''Hidden Detection Buff''' is a buff that grants all the towers affected by it hidden detection, meaning they can now attack [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies like the [[Shadow Boss]] or [[Soul]]. It can be displayed in two ways, either with an icon on the tower or the tower will receive the hidden detection icon in the upgrade menu. ==Mechanics== [[Units]], the [[Railgun Tank]], [[Body Guards 2]] or [[War Machine Sentry]] are not affected by the '''Hidden Detection Buff''', even if the unit or the tower that spawned it are in the range of the tower that applied the '''Hidden Detection Buff''' to them. ==Applied By== The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Hidden Detection Buff''' to other towers: *[[Ace Pilot]] (Passive) *[[UAV]] (Passive) *[[Firework Technician]] (Passive at the start of the wave) *[[Easter Egg]] (Passive for 20 seconds) The following event features can apply the '''Hidden Detection Buff''' to towers: * [[The Sun]] (Passive at the start of the wave, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]]) ==Trivia== *This buff can stack if a tower receives it from multiple sources, though this does not have any effects on the tower. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Attribute icon}} HiddenDetection.png|Icon that appears on the Upgrade Menu. }} ==Update Log== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Hidden Detection Buff''' added. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Hidden Detection Buff''' now makes the hidden detection icon appear in the upgrade menu when given to a tower. {{BuffsNavBox}}
